extracted.intended_audience: printers, typographers, book designers, typesetters, and font buyers
extracted.subtask_description: A printed type specimen sheet showing multiple typefaces, their style variants, and sizes with running text, titles, figures, and special characters to evaluate appearance and legibility for book composition and advertising use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Typeface/Font Family Identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Each specimen is labeled by its type name (e.g., CASLON OLD STYLE, SCOTCH ROMAN, BOOKMAN OLD STYLE, CHELTENHAM OLD STYLE, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present the family name prominently above or beside the specimens so viewers can identify which face is being shown and compare across families.

rubrics_metrics.name: Point Size Specification
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimens are shown at explicit point sizes (e.g., SIX POINT, EIGHT POINT, TEN POINT, TWELVE POINT, FOURTEEN POINT, EIGHTEEN POINT, TWENTY-FOUR POINT, THIRTY-SIX POINT, FORTY-EIGHT POINT, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Display the same sample copy across a range of point sizes to evaluate how the face performs from small text sizes to large display sizes; label each size clearly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style/Weight Variants
rubrics_metrics.description: Each face is displayed in available variants and styles: plain/roman, italic, bold, bold condensed, condensed, wide, extended, italic condensed, bold italic, etc. (e.g., CHELTENHAM BOLD, CHELTENHAM WIDE, CHELTENHAM CONDENSED, CHELTENHAM BOLD ITALIC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show all relevant weights and styles so a user can assess differences in color, emphasis, and suitability for headings versus body text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Display (Title) vs. Body Text Presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimens include both set display lines in all-caps for titles (e.g., 'THE FIRST TIME THAT THE GRAND PROSPECT HAD BEEN HELD FORTH') and running paragraphs for body text (the Polybius sample).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide both headline/display examples and continuous text to show how the face handles different compositional roles; include uppercase and mixed-case samples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Running Sample Copy Selection
rubrics_metrics.description: A consistent running text is used across specimens: 'When thoughtful Greeks like Polybius saw the fall of Carthage and of Corinth, they must have felt that they had reached one of the great turning-points in the world's history.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a representative passage that contains varied letterforms and word-shapes so readers can judge readability, rhythm, and texture of the face in continuous setting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Numerals and Figures
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimens display numeral sequences such as '1234567890' and set figure specimens (including advertising figures and 'figure' illustrations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show numerals in each size and style to evaluate figure design (lining vs. oldstyle, tabular vs. proportional) and their visual weight relative to letters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special Characters and Punctuation
rubrics_metrics.description: Pages include miscellaneous signs and punctuation samples (e.g., '= - + H---»-x±<^ =1=^5 ^ = • • • /', advertising figures, and other glyphs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a range of punctuation and symbol glyphs to check spacing, clarity, and compatibility with text and figures at various sizes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accented Letters and Diacritics
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimens show 'ACCENTED LETTERS — SIX TO TWELVE POINT' and explicit accented character sequences to demonstrate diacritic design.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide accented characters across sizes and styles to ensure correct diacritic placement and legibility for languages that require them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-Latin Script Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimens present non-Latin scripts and language blocks (GREEK, ANTIQUE GREEK, INSCRIPTION GREEK, HEBREW, NESTORIAN SYRIAC, ARABIC, ETHIOPIC) in various sizes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show representative text in each supported script to assess glyph completeness, script-specific metrics, and visual harmony with Latin text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Small-size Legibility and Fine Detail
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimens include very small sizes (e.g., SIX POINT, EIGHT POINT) to illustrate how letterforms render at fine sizes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate hairlines, counters, and spacing at small sizes to ensure acceptable legibility for footnotes, captions, or dense text settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Display/Headline Scale and Impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Large display sizes (e.g., TWENTY-FOUR, THIRTY-SIX, FORTY-EIGHT POINT) are shown to demonstrate effectiveness in headlines and titles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess stroke contrast, spacing, and overall aesthetic at display scales; ensure the face holds character and impact when scaled up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertising Figures and Tabular Sets
rubrics_metrics.description: Special sets labelled 'ADVERTISING FIGURES' and 'ADVERTISING FIGURES — ALL SIZES' provide grouped numeric/figure demonstrations (e.g., sequences '1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use dedicated figure sets to judge the suitability of numerals for posters, ads, and tables where numerals are prominent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lettercase and Small Caps Samples
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimens show capital-only lines and mixed-case paragraphs; headings often use all-caps lines to display uppercase shapes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include small-caps or uppercase-only treatments so designers can judge how capitals perform in display contexts and how case affects texture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special/Decorative and Combined Faces
rubrics_metrics.description: Pages show decorative or specialized faces (e.g., ENGRAVER'S BOLD, COPPERPLATE, BLACK GOTHIC, INTERCHANGEABLE GOTHIC) and combination uses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present specialty faces and their combinations with body text to evaluate ornamentation, legibility, and appropriate uses (display, advertising, titling).

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive Specimen Organization and Labeling
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimens are organized by family and style with size labels and section headings like 'SPECIMENS OF TYPES IN USE' and consistent formatting across pages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain clear organization and consistent labeling so users can quickly compare faces, sizes, and styles across the specimen catalog.
